properties.name: kolbasa.standalone.schema.enabled
properties.description: Whether to create or update the tables of the standalone queues at startup. Switch it off when someone else manages the schema, a DBA or Flyway.

properties.name: kolbasa.workers.auto-startup
properties.description: Whether to start the QueueWorker beans once the application is up. Switch it off to keep them stopped, for example in tests.
